newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel bids to keep Thomson group intact.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel bids to keep Thomson group intact.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom said on Wednesday that it had submitted an offer to the government to acquire the Thomson SA group as a whole as part of its privatisation process.
Alcatel said it wanted to turn Thomson into the European leader in defence and the number two worldwide to meet competition from the U.S. defence industry.
Separately, Alcatel Alsthom said it planned to offer to buy out minority stakeholders in the Thomson-CSF affiliate of Thomson SA as part of its offer to acquire Thomson from the French government.

Alcatel said that it seeks to form a partnership with another major European industrial player of the sector. But, it added, it had not made any prior commitment in order to enter into negotiations with its potential partners under optimum conditions.
Alcatel said the link with Thomson Multimedia would allow the group to capture new markets emerging from the convergence of consumer electronics and communication networks.

Alcatel said its Thomson proposal offered clear medium-term perspectives for value enhancement without for the short term diluting Alcatel's earnings per share outlook nor will it have a negative impact on the group's consolidated debt ratio.
Alcatel said it plans to reinforce links between the new group and semiconductor-maker SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV while respecting the autonomy of that company.
